items.title: Viewer zoom
items.text: Zoom viewer panes browser-style with a trackpad pinch or Cmd+/Cmd−, and Cmd+0 to reset back to 100%.

items.title: Agent-restart "What's new"
items.text: When the background terminal process needs a restart, the dialog now explains why it's asking and shows an offline summary of what actually changed in that update, so you can decide with full context. Clearer copy throughout.

items.title: Reliable viewer copy/paste & focus
items.text: Copy and paste now work correctly in viewer panes, with browser-like focus behavior.
